book.title: WAI PII EPE MATYUAME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Niki Pyakaengesa Tange Akali Masepae Singi Dupa

Erote baa kiŋi katea gii dokopa, Jisasa baa yuu andake Judia, taono Betelema dokonya mandea. Mandipiamopa niki pyakaengesa tange akali masepae singi mendapu Jerusalema ipupala, endakali dupa lamaiyoo,
“Juumanya kiŋi katapengena latae, wane ŋaŋa dokonya bui doko niki pyakaengesa-kaita katamupa naimame kandatala, baa mambo pyala epelyamanona, wane doko anja mandipae silyape?” leami.
Dopa lelyamino lapae doko Kiŋi Eroteme sepala, baa masepae longo nyia. Jerusalema tange endakali dupa pitakame sepala, masepae longo nyiamiaka.
Israele dupanya prisa mupapi, Mosesanya loo mana nyepaepi, dupa pitaka Eroteme epena lao nyoo kambu pia. Kambu pyatala dokaita tipa pyoo, “Kraisa doko yuu andukunya mandipengepe?” lea.

Dopa leamopa dokaitame pii yanu pyao, “Goteme propeta mende-kisa pii mende lea doko dapa lao pepa pyapae silyamo: ‘Yuu Juda dokonya taono Betelema tange dupa, nyakamanya taono doko taono waka Juda silyamo dupanya pundipundi nasilyamo, etete daa. Nyakamanya mandipaenya mandipae dupanya isingi akali mende pyakalyeta dokome nambanya Israele endakali dupa setao katakatana’ lao pepa pyapae silyamo. Dokonya, Kraisa doko yuu Judia dokonya taono Betelema mandipengena” leami.
Dopa lateaminopa, Eroteme niki pyakaengesa tange akali masepae singi dupa waa katao epena latala, bui doko gii andukupa katapyape lao pii nyalanya tipa pia.
Dopa petala, dokaita Betelema pena latala lamaiyoo, “Nyakama pupala, wane doko kutakondape pyoo kutalapape. Kutao kandatala dokopa, nambame apata mambo pyala patona, langya ipupape” lea.
Dopa lateamopa, kiŋi dokonya pii dupa sepala dokaita peami. Peaminopa, niki pyakaengesa-kaita wamba bui kateamopa kandeami dokoaka wambao pao, wane mandipae sia dokonya katea.
Kateamopa dokaitame bui doko kandatala, etete eteke piami.

Eteke pyao andaka kolandatala, wane doko baanya endangi Mariapa peteambino kandeami. Kandatala akali dupa luma lakapala, wane doko mambo piami. Mambo pyapala, dokaitanya nuu dupa tangupala, golopi, kena tunduma pingi pautapi, wele epe tunduma pipaepi, dupa baa opaa maiyami.
Maitiaminopa Goteme akali dokaita Erote kalyamo dokonya-kaita pilyala naena lao kombea pimaiya. Pimaitiamopa akali dokaita kaitini waka mendenya-kaita nyakamanya yuu dokonya pilyiami.
Paka Ijipi Peamino Doko

Akali dokaita pateaminopa, Kamongonya enjele mende kombeame ipupala Josepe lamaiyoo, “Eroteme wane doko pyao kumasotoo lao kutalanya pilyamona, emba sakatatala, wane dokopa, endangipa dolapo lanyoo paka Ijipi pupala, dokonya katape. Katatenopa, nambame emba pilya lato gii dokopa pilyetena” lea.
Dopa lateamopa, kuka gii dokopaka Josepe sakatatala, wane dokopa, endangipa dolapo lanyoo Ijipi pea.

Pupala Josepe Ijipi katao, Erote kumia gii dokonya tuu lea. Dopa piamo dokome, Kamongome propeta mende-kisa lao pituu, “Nambanya ikiningi doko Ijipi yuu doko yakinatala epena leona” lapae singi doko angi jia.
Wane Ŋaŋa Dupa Pyao Kumasiamino Doko

Niki pyakaengesa tange akali masepae singi dupame Erote baa minakasetala pumi-lumu lao masetala, baa etete imbu kaeya. Imbu kaeyapala baame bui doko gii andukupa kateape lao, akali dupa tipa piamo doko masia. Masetala Betelemapi, yuu dosa makisa singipi, dupanya pupala, wane ane ee kana laponya anatena patae dupa pitaka baanya amii dupame pyao kumasala pena lea.

Dopa pina lea dokome, propeta Jeremaeyame lao pituu, “Taono Rama dokonya Resolome baanya wane dupa kondo kaeyapala ee lao yamataka lao peteamopa, endakali dupame siami. Baanya wane dupa nakateaminosa, endakali mendeme baa yatae laa naena lao tuu piana” lapae singi doko angi jia.
Nasarete Pilyiamino Doko
Erote kumateamopa, Josepe baa Ijipi katea dokonya, Kamongonya enjele mende kombeame ipupala baa lamaiyoo,
“Wane doko pyalanya kutiamino akali dupa kumatelyaminona, emba sakatatala, wane dokopa, endangipa dolapo lanyoo Israele yuu dokonya puu” lea.
Dopa lateamopa Josepe sakatatala, wane dokopa endangipa dolapo lanyoo Israele yuu dokonya pea.

Dokopa Akelesame baanya takange Erotenya panda nyepala, Judia yuu dokonya kiŋi kalyamo lapae sepala, Josepe yuu dokonya paanya paka kaeya. Dokopa Josepe baa Judia nakatena lao Goteme kombeame lamaiya dokonya, baa Galali pea.
Pupala taono Nasarete lenge dokonya katea. Dopa pia dokome, propeta dupame lao pituu, “Baa Nasarete tangena latamina” lapae singi doko angi jia.
